hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Eastern Asia, northern half of the Korean Peninsula bordering the Korea Bay and the Sea of Japan, between China and South Korea || mostly hills and mountains separated by deep, narrow valleys; wide coastal plains in west, discontinuous in east || strategic location bordering China, South Korea, and Russia; mountainous interior is isolated and sparsely populated || Resources: coal, iron ore, limestone, magnesite, graphite, copper, zinc, lead, precious metals, hydropower || Exports: fake hair, iron alloys, tungsten ore, electricity, cars (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly hills and mountains separated by deep, narrow valleys; wide coastal plains in west, discontinuous in east || Eastern Asia, northern half of the Korean Peninsula bordering the Korea Bay and the Sea of Japan, between China and South Korea

climate.excerpt: temperate, with rainfall concentrated in summer; long, bitter winters || late spring droughts often followed by severe flooding; occasional typhoons during the early fall volcanism: P'aektu-san (2,744 m) (also known as Baitoushan, Baegdu, or Changbaishan), on the Chinese border, is considered historically active

economy.excerpt: one of the last centrally planned economies; hard hit by COVID-19, crop failures, international sanctions, and isolationist policies; declining growth and trade, and heavily reliant on China; poor exchange rate stability; economic data integrity issues || Exports: fake hair, iron alloys, tungsten ore, electricity, cars (2023) || Industries: military products; machine building, electric power, chemicals; mining (coal, iron ore, limestone, magnesite, graphite, copper, zinc, lead, and precious metals), metallurgy; textiles, food processing; tourism

peopleAndCulture.from: People and Society > Languages, Religions, Ethnic groups, Urbanization
peopleAndCulture.excerpt: traditionally Buddhist and Confucian, some Christian and syncretic Chondogyo (Religion of the Heavenly Way) || racially homogeneous; there is a small Chinese community and a few ethnic Japanese
